translation_notes: prefixes: owl->owl, rdfs->rdfs, d3fend->d3fend, skos->skos; the module-level `Namespace(...)` definitions of the original become `@prefix` (the RDF.type / RDFS.label / d3fend["attack-id"] / d3fend[revoked_by] forms become `a`, `rdfs:label`, `d3fend:attack-id`, `d3fend:{revoked_by}`)

the 4 / 5 / 6 consecutive adds on attack_uri of each branch become ONE `+{ s a owl:Class ; ... }` per branch (15 adds -> 5 islands); `owl:deprecated True` is the Turtle boolean `true` (Literal(True) is "true"^^xsd:boolean)

`Literal(x)` on a string is the plain interpolation `{x}`; mod_label / attack_id / pref_label / comment_text are strings in every call (labels come from STIX names); had one been None, the original would write the literal "None" and the interpolation would raise TypeError -- `{Literal(x)}` is the fully faithful form

`build` is not importable here (the installed `build` is PyPA's, and the repository's own build.py defines no `_xmlns`): context_shim.py carries `_xmlns`, a `get_graph` stub, and VERBATIM copies of get_framework_labels, get_deprecated_comment, ensure_superclasses and the tactic tables from update_attack.py
`@graph graph` declared in the function after `attack_uri`; ensure_superclasses(graph, ...) keeps its rdflib calls (outside the region)
